Name: Burger cat reskin
Author: Keventhewolf
Description:
to install simplify replace the files in the proper location

place cat2.xnb into the animals folder (Stardew Valley > content > animals)

place Cursors.xnb into the LooseSprites folder (Stardew Valley > content > looseSprites)

this will replace the current cat2 sprite, I would recommend saving a backup of the original game sprites in case you want to go back to the original.
